subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Describe, compare and order numbers to 75
source.subtopic: Describe and compare numbers to 50, 60, 70 and 75 across the term: smaller than, greater than

show.line: Which is greater, forty-seven or sixty-two? Look at the tens first. Six tens beat four tens. Sixty-two is greater!

rounds.praise: Fifty-eight! Five tens is more than three tens.

rounds.prompt: Which number is smaller than forty?
Sixty-three and sixty-eight. Which one is greater? Say the number.
Put them in order from smallest to greatest. Twenty-one, thirty-six, fifty. Which number comes next?
rounds.praise: Seventy-four! It is the greatest of all.

rounds.prompt: Which number is one more than sixty-nine?
Which number is ten less than seventy-five?
Smaller than fifty, or greater than fifty? Put each number in its group.

hints: Look at the tens digit first. More tens means a greater number.
If the tens are the same, look at the ones.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will say which is greater, thirty-nine or forty-one.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Thirty-nine is greater. Nine is a big number!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Look at the tens first. Four tens beat three tens. Forty-one is greater.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look at the tens together. Three tens, four tens. Forty-one is greater!

parent_line: Can say which of two numbers up to 75 is greater or smaller.
